name: Aurora Fest
description: Vivid night-sky site for a three-day outdoor music and arts festival with morphing aurora blobs, a lineup marquee and glowing ticket tiers.
features: Slowly morphing teal, violet and pink gradient blobs over a starry hero, paused off-screen
Two-row infinite lineup marquee that pauses on hover, focus or with a pause button
Three ticket tiers with animated glowing gradient borders on hover and focus
Night-by-night lineup, experience grid, travel planner with festival hours, FAQ and contact form
signature: Liquid aurora gradient blobs drift and morph behind the hero; an infinite lineup marquee and ticket tiers that glow on hover
